title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.log_anti_left
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.log_anti_left` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {b c n : ℕ}, 1 < c → c ≤ b → Nat.log b n ≤ Nat.log c n
